title: Deleting an expense of 230: the money goes back to the treasury in both systems; the reference system erases the journal, this application keeps it and writes its reversal

delete_000005.note: Expense 000005 deleted after a confirmation page: its journal 000142 disappeared with no reversing journal and the treasury went from 480 to 250 less the 230 it had taken, that is it got the 230 back

cases.reason: The reference system erases the journal of a deleted expense and keeps only a log. The owner decided (E15) that deleting a document with a journal reverses it, so the books keep the original and its reversal and the audit trail shows both.
